svg.text: FIS Chaos H — ARC Zonal Shift on an Auto Scaling group (NLB + EC2 ASG + Aurora)
Same fault as G-2 against a zonal-shift-enabled ASG: the replacement lands in the healthy AZ only while a zonal shift is active
Public subnet (no NAT, egress via AZ-1)
Identical to G-2. Run twice: without,
then with, an active zonal shift on AZ-1.
AZ-2 only while the shift is active.
not replaced here during an active shift
